title: Patch: fused Spells, Combo-Index grades and KY's Constant off the field
notes: Issue #3800: engine and card fixes for the daily fuzz. Duos seed 1628's fused Spell, flagged for its end-of-turn return on a Field Spell's end-of-turn text, is fixed by #3806's R3806002, merged from main. A Combo-Index text run after its card left the field writes no grade (R3800001; seed 6091). A cost set on a card in a graveyard or an exile pile changes nothing (R3800002; seed 6140). C+ #37 Wardrum's end of turn casts from the non-Units played before the turn's end began, not another Wardrum's copies (R3800003; seed 5763). S #23 Warp Disruptor and S #24 Warp Disruptor II answer each card once a turn, so a Unit that resummons itself as it dies ends its loop (R3800004; seed 9999). S+ #104 Tireless Cultivation's Radiant face gives its Temporary 2 only to a card that reaches the hand, not one a full hand burned (seed 8687). Flak v3, v4 and v5 keep their `damage` script through v0.5.8b, so a past version from v0.5.8b no longer panics (R767000; seed 5172). No catalog change: the plays are the families `classify` finds playing differently in its forced and unforced games.

player.title: Fused cards behave off the field
fixes: A Combo-Index card that left the field mid-effect no longer keeps a grade.
Setting the cost of a card that was just discarded or exiled no longer changes its price.
Several Radiant Wardrums no longer recast each other's copies at the end of your turn: each casts the Spells, Field Spells and Traps you played before the turn ended.
A Radiant Tireless Cultivation burned by a full hand no longer keeps its Temporary in your graveyard.
Warp Disruptor and Warp Disruptor II attack a given card at most once a turn, so a Unit that comes back as it dies no longer locks the game in an endless loop.
